title: Austin Housing: City Land and Weekly Meetings
summary:
*   The Housing Subcommittee met to discuss Austin's critical housing problems and potential solutions.
*   The committee established a regular meeting schedule, agreeing to convene every Tuesday at 2:00 p.m. to focus on housing initiatives.
*   City staff were directed to compile a comprehensive list of all City-owned property suitable for use in future housing programs.

COUNCIL HOUSING SUBCOMMITTEE
1ST FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM - MUN. BLDG.
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Councilmember Urdy
called to order the special called meeting of the Council's Housing Subcommittee, noting
the presence of all members: Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Urdy, Humphrey and
Rose.
Discussion ensued by Councilmembers, staff and committee members concerning housing
problems and programs in Austin. Councilmember Urdy suggested the committee set
priorities. Councilmember Rose was of the opinion the committee should set a time, one day
a week, to have different entities meet with the committee. It was agreed, on
Councilmember Humphrey's suggestion, that the Council's Housing Sub-Committee should meet
every Tuesday at 2:00p.m. Mayor Pro Tem Trevino instructed the City Manager to instruct
staff to compile a list of City-owned property which might be utilized for a housing
program.
By concensus the committee agreed to meet each Tuesday at 2:00p.m.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:20 p.m.
